content: {"summary":"Users report that after signing out and back into Apple ID, many purchased songs disappear from their phone library while remaining on the computer [#tk_87214]. They also struggle to download purchased tracks to their laptop, seeing only previews and no download option [#tk_2285356]. Some customers experience sudden playback interruptions, ads, and sluggish device performance during music playback [#tk_2297634]. Issues with iOS 11 lock‑screen controls and missing explicit versions of songs further frustrate users [#tk_2631494] [#tk_2708474]. Finally, restoring a phone from an iTunes backup can erase all downloaded Apple Music tracks, leaving no easy way to re‑download them [#tk_491487]"}
